thread:
nina: Customer 'MerchantPilot' wants an on-site HSM import for the pilot. Requirements: FIPS HSM, no plaintext key export, and rotation every 30 days. Can we accommodate?

raja: Yes. We support wrapped-key import and can accept signed rotation attestations. Need to confirm courier/onsite ops and whether they require a sealed escrow.

claire: Technical constraints: wrapped import requires their HSM produce a PKCS#7-wrapped blob we verify. We'll store only the wrapped blob; unwrapping never happens on our side.

cust-rep: They also want audit events forwarded to their Splunk. Is syslog or HTTPS webhook ok?

claire: Both supported. SOW will include setup for webhook and S3 archival if requested. They need to provide endpoint and cert.

ops: On rotation: for zero-downtime we recommend dual-key serving during cutover (48-72h overlap). Perf impact: expect ~5-10ms p99 increase on first requests during new sessions.

legal-bot: Note: holding pre-signed escrow requires signed addendum. Third-party custodian strongly preferred if they insist keys never leave their control.

nina: Pricing ballpark: remote attestation path + wrapped import = +$12k-$18k. Onsite courier + escrow handling = +$30k-$50k. I'll include tiered options in the quote.

raja: Action items: nina to draft SOW with three tiers (remote, courier+escrow, custodian escrow) by tomorrow; ops to run a quick perf check in staging for p99 delta; legal to confirm escrow clause template.

cust-rep: I'll get Splunk endpoint and confirm courier need by Friday. Thanks.

nina: Great, thanks everyone. Will post SOW draft here when ready.
